item.description:
# Airborne 0.3.27
- Moves map settings into one native Map controls panel. It starts closed on Mac and opens on demand; iPhone uses a scrolling sheet. Simple/Analyst and the current map summary stay visible. - Improves readability with system backgrounds, direct SwiftUI pickers, and clearer camera selection. Renames My area to Regional. - Restores all available trends and graphs in Simple area details, with individual reporting dates and sources. Simple keeps area colors and tap/click details; Analyst keeps configurable signal markers and comparisons.
